question: What is the average customer age?
verdict_why: every axis an expectation of COMMIT requires passes

answer_sql:
WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(order_date) AS ref_date
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(DATE_PART('year', AGE(a.ref_date, c.birth_date))), 2) AS average_customer_age
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
CROSS JOIN as_of AS a
WHERE
  c.valid_from <= a.ref_date AND c.valid_end > a.ref_date
